findings.summary: addressed — Idle-timer release ignores hasReachedSection; a >150ms scroll-event gap unlocks mid smooth-scroll (BR-002). Gate release on target reached or a hard deadline.
addressed — Unconditional preventDefault blocks modifier-click/open-in-new-tab on menu anchors.

addressed — Keyboard/scrollbar interruption is not a user takeover; touchstart on the tab row releases the page lock mid-scroll.

KudosPromo wide variant keeps sizes hint at 1120px for a 1152px card; negligible.
Award image alt repeats adjacent h2 title; acceptable as the PNG carries name artwork.

Vertical wheel/touch starting on the overflowing tab row (<1024) is treated as a sideways row scroll, so the lock is not cancelled; the deadline release then pins anchorY at an unreached offset and the active item stays stale until the next scroll. Fix: exclude only sideways gestures, or release(false) and recompute when the deadline expires with the target unreached.
Fix round added no regression test for modifier-click or scroll-key takeover. Add a Ctrl-click test and a PageDown-during-click-scroll test.
